text:
morgan: quick async standup — SLOs / alerts / oncall followups. TL;DR: we saw a short latency burn in us-west around 11:00–12:00, kv-evict canary caused p95 tail increase; rolled back. details below.

alex: did the initial kv-evict canary rollforward at 11:05, observed p95 jump ~120ms, reverted at 11:18. pushing logs to #observability and attaching a few example request ids.

priya: can you paste the grafana/prom query + threshold so I can add to the postmortem?

alex: grafana panel uses this promql for p99: 
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
alert condition: p99 > 200ms for 3m. also seeing increased retry rate for cold-paths.

jamal: @morgan I took the oncall page — alerted at 11:12. muted noisy pager rule after confirming retries. filed INC-4572 for followup and tagged infra.

ops-bot: Alert: high_latency_us-west fired 11:07 - severity: P2 - acknowledged by jamal.

morgan: blockers: need a short experiment to validate prefix-KV warmup before eviction. proposal: for the next canary, increase warmup window from 60s -> 300s (canary-only). this should reduce cold-path tail.

alex: can do. I'll prepare a canary config + rollout YAML and smoke test that hits cold path. ETA ~30m.

priya: if we extend warmup, we should tweak autoscaler thresholds too to avoid accidental burst scaling during the warmup. leaving a note in the playbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/ops/playbooks/kv-eviction

jamal: I'll add a 90s debounce to the high_latency alert during the experiment window and keep an eye on error budget burn. will roll back debounce if it hides problems.

morgan: today: finish canary + add automated smoke test that simulates cold prefix access; add a small eval set to detect regressions in p95/p99 latency. also want a quick CR review for the canary YAML after alex posts it.

alex: pinging @priya for CR: infra/kv-evict-canary.yaml :thumbsup:

priya: :eyes: will review in ~1hr.

morgan: thanks all — post any followups here. I'll update the incident deck with timeline + graphs later today.
